venueWorkers.title: Venue listing workers
venueWorkers.objective: Keep high-value venue calendars fresh by revisiting known reliable venue websites on a predictable cadence.

done.title: Capability fits the Source Registry model
done.detail: Known venue websites are sources. Their pages can be scheduled, observed, interpreted into event claims and deduped through the normal projection path.

now.title: Define the watched-venue registry
now.detail: Identify venues with reliable, actively maintained listings and store source URL, parsing/acquisition strategy, cadence and last successful scan.

next.title: Weekly venue worker schedule
next.detail: Run one source job per watched venue weekly, with retry/backoff and a faster cadence only where evidence justifies it.

next.title: Delta new listings into Claims
next.detail: Only new/changed gigs become claims. Existing gigs dedupe normally; removed listings are not treated as cancellations unless source semantics are explicit.

next.title: Venue freshness dashboard
next.detail: Show last checked, last changed, failures and new gigs found in Godmode so reliable sources can be expanded safely.
